leads.detail: Shanghai Aoyi Information Technology Co., Ltd. (OYi Technology) announced the completion of a D-round financing of several hundred million yuan.
leads.why_relevant: As a BME MS student focused on biosignal-ML and neuromodulation, OYi's work bridging brain-computer interfaces, electromyography, and embodied neural interfaces offers direct exposure to neural signal decoding and hardware-software integration.

leads.detail: San Diego-based Burl Concepts received 510(k) clearance (number K260813) for its portable brain ultrasound system, Foqus.
leads.why_relevant: This portable brain ultrasound system provides a robust digital signal acquisition platform, which aligns with signal processing and diagnostic instrumentation coursework for a biomedical engineering student.

leads.detail: The Brisbane medical technology company has raised AUD $5 million in an oversubscribed pre-Series A round.
leads.why_relevant: Laronix applies machine learning and voice AI to reconstruct speech from neural and physiological signals, presenting an exciting opportunity for an MS BME student specialized in biosignal ML.

leads.detail: Samsung secured US FDA and Korea MFDS regulatory approvals for its upgraded sleep apnoea feature on the Galaxy Ring.
leads.why_relevant: Consumer health wearables integrating clinical-grade algorithms like sleep apnea detection provide valuable practical insight into physiological signal processing and embedded machine learning.

leads.detail: PolyNovo Limited submitted its FDA Premarket Approval Application for NovoSorb BTM in full-thickness burns.
leads.why_relevant: Though more biomaterials-focused, tracking FDA submissions from established medtech companies helps understand the regulatory pathways and clinical translation pipelines critical for a BME student.
